title: Bạn đang lãng phí 90% cuộc đời bằng những thứ sai — đây là cách dừng lại
script: Bạn biết không? Có một nghiên cứu từ Harvard nói rằng 90% những gì chúng ta lo lắng mỗi ngày... sẽ không bao giờ xảy ra. Chín bạn. Không phải bạn. Bạn đang dành cả đời để lo về những thứ không tồn tại. Trong khi điều bạn thực sự cần... đang chờ bạn ở đâu đó ngoài vùng thoải mái. Hôm nay, mình nói với bạn một sự thật: Bạn không thiếu thời gian. Bạn thiếu sự dũng cảm.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman sitting alone at cafe, staring at phone screen glowing blue light [Static]. Drops phone on table, looks up at ceiling taking deep breath [Slow push in]. Stands up suddenly, walks toward door with determination [Tracking shot following movement]. Steps outside into sunlight, closes eyes feeling breeze [Wide shot with nature background]. Sets small notebook on park bench, writes with pen [Close up hands writing]. Urban rooftop sunset, confident posture, cinematic golden hour lighting, 9:16 portrait.
thumbnail_idea: Woman at cafe looking at phone, dramatic lighting, contrast between blue screen light and golden sunlight
visual_scene: A cozy urban cafe with warm ambient lighting, a young woman in her early twenties sitting alone at a small wooden table by the window. She stares at her phone screen glowing blue light on her face, expression confused and worried. She suddenly drops the phone on the table and looks up at the ceiling, taking a deep breath. She stands up with sudden determination, grabs her bag and walks toward the door. She steps outside into the morning sunlight, closes her eyes and feels the breeze on her face, a subtle smile forming. She sits on a park bench nearby, pulls out a small notebook and begins writing with intensity, her pen moving across the page with purpose. Golden hour sunset light bathes the scene, urban rooftop setting with city skyline in background, cinematic warm tones, portrait 9:16 framing.
